name: Sun-Pyre Witch-Courts
identity: Zealot witch-hunters, warrior-sisters and self-scourging penitents. Fragile bodies, burning weapons, and a bank of Pyre-Dice that turns one roll per activation into a miracle.

rules.name: Pyre-Dice
rules.description: Command Phase: roll 1 D6 and bank it as a Pyre-Die (keep the result). Also bank 1 when a friendly unit is destroyed. Maximum 3 banked. Once per activation, before rolling, you may replace ONE of your own Hit, Wound, ARM-save or Charge dice with a banked die. Pyre-Dice are never used on the opponent's rolls.

rules.name: Gamble — Martyr's Pyre
rules.description: Once per battle, when a unit activates, spend ALL banked Pyre-Dice (minimum 2): its weapons gain [SHREDDING WOUNDS] and +1 Damage this activation. The bank is empty afterwards. (Risk: resource.)

detachments.name: Burning Rose
detachments.playstyle: Flamers forward: close the distance, burn the objectives.

rules.name: Searing Purgation
rules.description: [SCORCH] weapons gain +1 PEN. Once per round, one [SCORCH] attack against a unit on an objective also inflicts D3 Fatal Wounds on a 5+.

enhancements.name: Ember of the First Pyre
enhancements.description: **Canoness of the Pyre** only. +1 Damage to melee attacks on a round she charged.

enhancements.name: Ash-Crown
enhancements.description: **Grand Inquisitrix** only. The attached unit gets +1 PEN with ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Purging Flame
stratagems.turn: A unit with [SCORCH] weapons is selected to Shoot
stratagems.effect: Re-roll its Wound rolls this activation.

stratagems.name: Wall of Fire
stratagems.turn: An enemy unit declares a Charge against a unit with [SCORCH] weapons
stratagems.effect: That unit's Retaliation Strike is made with one [SCORCH] weapon instead (hits automatically).

detachments.name: Penitent Host
detachments.playstyle: Bleed for it: chipped squads get deadlier, so the opponent must finish what they start.

rules.name: Blood of Martyrs
rules.description: Units below Starting Strength (or damaged, for single models) get +1 to Hit; below Half-Strength they also get +1 to Wound.

enhancements.name: Scourge of Contrition
enhancements.description: **Confessor-Firebrand** only. Friendly units within 6″ get +1 to Wound in melee on a round they charged.

enhancements.name: Martyr's Shroud
enhancements.description: **Canoness of the Pyre** only. The bearer has UNYIELDING 5+.

stratagems.name: Final Absolution
stratagems.turn: A friendly Class 1–2 unit is destroyed in melee
stratagems.effect: Before removal, its surviving models fight once more.

stratagems.name: Rush to Martyrdom
stratagems.turn: A unit below Starting Strength declares a Charge

detachments.name: Witch-Hunter Tribunal
detachments.playstyle: Hunt the leaders and casters, ignore the rest.

rules.name: Sentence of the Court
rules.description: Before the battle mark 2 enemy units (at least 1 must be a Leader or [PSYCHIC / ARCANE] unit if possible). Your attacks against Marked units re-roll Wound rolls of 1 and gain [PRECISION]. When a Marked unit is destroyed, bank 1 Pyre-Die.

enhancements.name: Seal of the Tribunal
enhancements.description: **Grand Inquisitrix** only. The attached unit re-rolls Wound rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Null-Lantern
enhancements.description: **Null-Maiden Warden** only. Null Aura range becomes 9″ and also applies to Fatal Wounds from spells (ignored on 5+).

stratagems.name: Interrogate
stratagems.turn: A unit ends a Fight action engaged with a Marked unit

stratagems.name: Burn the Witch
stratagems.turn: A unit targets a Marked [PSYCHIC / ARCANE] unit

stratagems.name: Sentence Passed
stratagems.effect: Move one Mark to a new enemy unit.
